person_made_it: Built at noon on the day for Gordon at Pier 80 with Dave and Trent: his plan A with the USA match, his Dog Blood history from his own ledger, his crew corrected the moment he corrected it, the official Saturday set times read from the festival's own image, and today's hourly weather for that exact pier.
emcee_who_is_speaking: The pier itself, in 3D: tap a stage and it tells you who is on and who is next from your phone's clock; Darby speaks once in the 44 second gate briefing; the plan builder hands the mic to Gordon.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: It changes with the real clock: afternoon sky over the water, sunset at 7:01, night for Robyn and Dog Blood, the Mellier idiom of one coral seed deriving teal, violet and gold overprints on a dark ground.
did_the_click_pay_me: Drag spins the pier, tap flies to a stage, the crowd bobs toward whoever is on, beams sweep, stars come out after sunset, star builds a plan with walking minutes, tap any artist for the music, three sound-alikes and the acts from his own 135-name ledger, a mood dial dims what does not fit, Surprise me pays out, the crane hides lasers.
works_for_the_recipient: Phone first at 390 wide, one thumb, touch orbit with no library, a static riso hero and the full schedule as plain HTML when WebGL or JavaScript is missing, big type for a dark pier, and the 3D is capped in pixel ratio so it stays cool on a phone battery.
taught_me_something: The official Saturday grid runs Despacio as a room from 2:45 to 9:45, while the festival's own info page lists a separate birthday Despacio party across the street at 401 Cesar Chavez, 5 to 11 PM, on its own ticket; the page says both and tells him to ask at the gate. And the wind at Pier 80 doubles between 3 and 7 PM, which is why the layer matters for Dog Blood more than the temperature does. And the bill is wired together: Soulwax, 2manydjs and Despacio are the same Dewaele brothers he saw at the Coliseum in 2022, and Last.fm lists Oskar Med K and Nimino as each other's neighbours, an hour apart on two stages.
told_me_the_truth: Artist notes cite Last.fm tags and similar artists read today; Felly Fell, Erika, SFCowboy, Alisha and Mike D 5D are marked unverified beyond the grid; the seen list comes only from his Fifteen Years record; the payment plan and the Despacio double listing are stated, not smoothed.
weakest: Walking minutes between rooms are my estimates from the pier's layout, not measured; if the Warehouse is farther than eight minutes from the Pier Stage, the clash flags are optimistic. No live crowd or wait time data.
